note: Development pass of the first draft of menu-held-frames.browser.mjs, in a scratch worktree at the fix commit 4fb7ee43f with the draft probe copied in; not counted. Killed by this session after 5 of 20 tests: each ran the expected item (Action file/image/command) but the menu then stayed mounted in its exit state and the menu-count expect timed out. Cause, found with a diagnostic script in the same scratch tree: the draft gave held frames negative ids, and floating-ui's autoUpdate cancels its sentinel id -1 from a ResizeObserver callback, which dropped Base UI's held frame-scheduler tick, so the exit's animations-finished check never ran. In a browser cancelAnimationFrame(-1) is a no-op; the committed probe (5a6ee008a) uses ids from 2^30 upward.
